answer: A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The dawn counter is kept in opal and quartz publishes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 48 aliases cost 174 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
